# Chennai Metro Rail App — Travel Planner Screen

## 1) Status Bar & Header
- **Status bar:** Medium blue (#3D6BB3-ish), white icons/text: "10:41", WhatsApp/Mail/keyboard icons, right: Bluetooth, "LTE", signal, battery "81%"
- **App bar:** Same blue (#3B67AF), left hamburger menu (3 white lines), white circular CMRL logo, white bold text **"CHENNAI METRO RAIL LIMITED"**

## 2) Sections (top → bottom)

### Sub-header
- Light lavender/blue bar (#DDE3F5) with circular light-blue back button (chevron-left) and label **"Travel Planner"** in blue (#3B67AF)

### Route Inputs
- Left rail: green filled circle (origin dot), dotted gray line, red map-pin (destination)
- Two white dropdown inputs with thin gray borders, dark gray placeholder text, black dropdown caret:
  - **"Meenambakkam"**
  - **"Government Estate"**

### Select Date & Time
- Section title **"Select Date & Time"** in dark navy
- Two pill-shaped inputs, very light blue fill (#E4EEF3):
  - Calendar icon + **"08/09/2025"**
  - Clock icon + **"05:00"**

### Journey Summary (3-column grid, thin gray dividers, white bg)
- **Left:** navy train-ticket icon, label "Ticket Fare", value **"₹ 40"** (large navy)
- **Middle (two stacked cells):**
  - "Station In Between" — crimson/red metro-train icon + big red number **"10"**
  - "Travel Time" — olive/yellow train-clock icon + big olive number **"29"**, "Min" suffix
- **Right:** blue location-pin route icons (dashed path), "Total Distance", big cyan-blue **"14.72"**, suffix **"Kms"**

### Upcoming Train Details
- Title **"Upcoming Train Details"** in navy
- Full-width blue banner (#4A73B8): white sun icon + **"04:53"** (left), white crescent-moon icon + **"23:10"** (right)
- Four dark indigo-blue circular badges (#3B4FA0), white text, time over divider over code:
  - **"05:00 / P2"**, **"05:04 / P2"**, **"05:07 / P2"**, **"05:14 / P2"**
- Speech-bubble tooltip (light blue-gray fill, tail pointing to first circle): **"This is a direct train"**

### Route Information (bottom)
- Light gray card with left navy accent bar, label **"Route Information"** (blue), minus (collapse) icon on right

## 3) Bottom Navigation
- No bottom nav bar — only the Android gesture bar (gray pill on white)

## 4) Exact Text Labels
"10:41", "LTE", "81%", "CHENNAI METRO RAIL LIMITED", "Travel Planner", "Meenambakkam", "Government Estate", "Select Date & Time", "08/09/2025", "05:00", "Station In Between", "10", "Ticket Fare", "₹ 40", "Travel Time", "29", "Min", "Total Distance", "14.72", "Kms", "Upcoming Train Details", "04:53", "23:10", "05:00", "05:04", "05:07", "05:14", "P2" ×4, "This is a direct train", "Route Information"

## 5) Color Palette
| Color | Hex (approx) | Use |
|---|---|---|
| Royal blue | #3B67AF | Header, status bar, banner |
| Light lavender | #DDE3F5 | Sub-header bar |
| Indigo | #3B4FA0 | Time circles |
| Navy | #2E4057 | Headings, fare value |
| Crimson red | #C03A50 | Stations count, origin pin |
| Olive/yellow | #A8A32A | Travel time |
| Cyan blue | #2196C9 | Distance, route pins |
| Light blue-gray | #E4EEF3 | Pills, tooltip |
| Green | #1E7A1E | Origin dot |
| White/gray | #FFFFFF / #F5F5F5 | Backgrounds, cards |

Font: sans-serif (Roboto-like), navy headings; large bold numerals for stats.
